Tags emitted (MyAgents convention): agent.session_id — from AgentTurnContext.SessionId agent.turn.tool_calls — from AgentTurnResult.Telemetry.ToolCalls agent.turn.duration_ms — from AgentTurnResult.Telemetry.TurnDuration Tags emitted (GenAI convention): gen_ai.operation.name — "chat.completion" gen_ai.request.model — from AgentTurnResult.Telemetry.ModelId gen_ai.response.model — from AgentTurnResult.Telemetry.ModelId gen_ai.usage.input_tokens — from AgentTurnResult.Telemetry.PromptTokens gen_ai.usage.output_tokens — from AgentTurnResult.Telemetry.CompletionTokens gen_ai.usage.total_tokens — PromptTokens + CompletionTokens On exception, the span status is set to Error with the exception message.

files.Summary:
Thrown by to unwind the workflow execution stack and hand a serializable snapshot back to the caller.

The caller pattern is:

try
{
    var state = await host.RunAsync(workflow, initialState);
}
catch (HumanInputRequiredException ex)
{
    // Persist ex.Snapshot — it contains the paused state and the prompt to show the user.
    // Later, collect the human's reply and resume:
    var finalState = await host.ResumeWithInputAsync(workflow, ex.Snapshot, humanReply);
}
